# @kayjs/seo Reference

> SEO `<head>` tags, `titleTemplate`, localized descriptions, canonical URLs, JSON-LD, `sitemap.xml` (i18n-aware), redirects, web manifest, favicons, and self-hosted fonts.

## Imports

- `@kayjs/seo`: `seo`, `jsonLd`; types `SeoPluginOptions`, `FontEntry`, `ManifestOptions`, `RedirectTarget`.

## Plugin Setup (`seo(options?)`)

- `site`: public origin (`https://example.com`, inherits `KayConfig.site`). Required for canonical links, absolute `og:image`, and `sitemap.xml`.
- `name`: site name (`og:site_name` and fallback `<title>`).
- `titleTemplate`: e.g. `'%s | My App'` (skips wrapping if `<title>` already contains `name`).
- `description`: `string` or `Record<locale, string>` (localized fallback when a page doesn't emit `<meta name="description">`; reads `ctx.locals.locale` from `@kayjs/i18n`).
- `image`, `imageAlt`: default `og:image`, `twitter:card` (`summary_large_image`), and `og:image:alt`.
- `locale`: default `og:locale`.
- `jsonLd`: array of Schema.org objects injected globally (`@context: 'https://schema.org'` auto-added).
- `sitemap`: `boolean` (default `true`, emitted in `afterPrerender` as `/sitemap.xml` with `xhtml:link` alternates when `@kayjs/i18n` is active). `sitemapExclude`: `string[]`. `extraUrls`: `() => string[]`.
- `redirects`: `Record<fromPath, string | { to: string, status?: 301 | 302 | 307 | 308 }>` (mounted as `GET` routes, default `301`).
- `favicon`: `string | string[]` (relative path or package specifier; emits `favicon.{svg,png,ico}` and `<link rel="icon">`).
- `manifest`: `{ name?, shortName?, description?, themeColor?, backgroundColor?, display?, startUrl? }` (emits `/manifest.webmanifest`).
- `fonts`: `Array<{ family, src, weight?, style?, display?, preload? }>` (resolves local paths or `@fontsource/*` specifiers, emits content-hashed assets + `@font-face` stylesheet + `<link rel="preload">`).

## Page-Specific JSON-LD

- `jsonLd(schema)` returns a branded `Html` value for `<Head>`: `<Head>{jsonLd({ '@type': 'Article', headline: title })}</Head>`.

## Snippet

```ts
// kay.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from '@kayjs/kay/config'
import { seo } from '@kayjs/seo'

export default defineConfig({
  site: 'https://example.com',
  plugins: [
    seo({
      name: 'Acme',
      titleTemplate: '%s | Acme',
      description: 'Fast web apps with Kay v2.',
      favicon: 'public/favicon.svg',
      fonts: [{ family: 'Inter', src: '@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2', weight: 400 }],
      redirects: { '/old': '/new' },
    }),
  ],
})
```
